notes: The 'was' of 'was twenty years old' is taken as the verbless clause's construction-supplied copula joining the predicate headed by בֶּן (rule 20); attaching it to the numeral phrase was the competing reading, but בֶּן is what 'old' realizes.
הַיָּשָׁר follows rule 41 exactly: the substantival article takes 'that which' headed on 'that', while the adjective keeps 'was right' under rule 20.
